rubric.revise_next: Review how fractions are simplified mathematically and practice explaining the purpose of each line in your constructor.

questions.prompt: In your `__init__`, why do you use `common = gcd(num, den)` and then divide both parts by it? What happens if you skip this step when comparing `Fraction(2, 4)` and `Fraction(1, 2)`?

questions.feedback: You did not explain the importance of handling the zero denominator case.
questions.prompt: Explain in your own words what this line of your code does, and why it's needed: `if den == 0: raise ZeroDivisionError("Denominator cannot be zero.")`
